_comment: Bundled default banner set. Shipped with every Community release so the carousel is populated when the banner subdomain is unreachable (isolated server, blocked outbound, CSP block, timeout, 404). The live feed at banner.felixschaller.com uses the same shape and overrides this set when reachable. Each item renders as an HTML+CSS card: top ~2/3 is the hero image (object-fit:cover), bottom ~1/3 is title + body + CTA, so content adapts to the ~200x1000 column instead of being baked into a fixed-aspect SVG. Links must stay on an allowed first-party host (felixschaller.com, xixum.ai, af-ax.com) or they are stripped.
